question: How should this app count what people do?

choices.label: No analytics — nothing is measured
choices.hint: Nothing is sent anywhere and no consent banner is needed.

choices.label: Google Analytics
choices.hint: Free, and what most reporting expects. Needs a consent banner in the EU and UK.

fields.label: Measurement ID
fields.hint: Admin → Data streams → your web stream. It starts with G-.

choices.label: PostHog
choices.hint: Product analytics with funnels and session replay. Self-hostable.

fields.label: Project API key
fields.hint: Project settings → Project API key. It starts with phc_ and belongs in the page.

fields.label: Host
fields.hint: Which region, or your own instance. Optional; defaults to their US host.

choices.label: Plausible
choices.hint: No cookies and no personal data, so no consent banner. Paid, and lighter than the others.

fields.label: Site domain
fields.hint: Exactly as you added it in Plausible, with no https:// and no trailing slash.

fields.label: Host
fields.hint: Their host, or your own instance. Optional.
